text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so I found the bugs by reading the code and tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies come from the search tests' `Emma` record, since the factory tests only check the title.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
